q: Does a vehicle workshop count emissions from used engine oil?
title: Workshops: used engine oil emissions
short: Only if you burn it. Used oil sold to an authorised re-refiner or recycler is not your emission; keep the disposal receipts. Used oil burned in a heater or boiler on your site is Scope 1 fuel combustion, counted from the litres burned.
audience: Car, truck and two-wheeler service workshops and fleet maintenance yards

p: Oil passed to an authorised recycler is waste leaving your site. The emissions of treating it sit in your Scope 3, category 5, if you report that category.
Burning waste oil for heat is fuel combustion in Scope 1. Record litres burned and use the IPCC default for waste oils, or your supplier's analysis.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
